parameters.name: IgnoreFailedNodeTasks
parameters.description: Specifies whether to skip failed nodes. Default value: False.

parameters.name: IpAllocationPolicy
parameters.description: The combined IP allocation policy. Each policy can use only one policy type, and multiple policies can be combined.

sub_parameters.name: BondPolicy
sub_parameters.description: Specifies the cluster subnet ID based on the bond name.

sub_parameters.name: Amount
sub_parameters.description: The number of nodes to purchase. Valid values: 0 to 500. If Amount is set to 0, no nodes are purchased and existing nodes are used for scale-out. If Amount is set to a value from 1 to 500, the specified number of nodes are purchased and used for scale-out. Default value: 0

sub_parameters.name: AutoRenew
sub_parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the purchased nodes. This parameter takes effect when Amount is not 0 and ChargeType is set to PREPAY or POSTPAY. Valid values: True: Enable auto-renewal. False: Disable auto-renewal. Default value: False.

sub_parameters.name: ChargeType
sub_parameters.description: The billing method of the nodes. This parameter does not take effect when Amount is set to 0. Valid values: PREPAY: subscription. POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go. Default value: PREPAY.

sub_parameters.name: Hostnames
sub_parameters.description: The hostnames of the purchased nodes. This parameter does not take effect when Amount is set to 0.

sub_parameters.name: LoginPassword
sub_parameters.description: The logon password of the purchased nodes. This parameter does not take effect when Amount is set to 0.

sub_parameters.name: Period
sub_parameters.description: The subscription duration of the purchased nodes. Unit: months. Valid values: 1, 6, 12, 24, 36, and 48. This parameter takes effect when Amount is not 0 and ChargeType is set to PREPAY.

sub_parameters.name: UserData
sub_parameters.description: The custom executable shell script. The script must be Base64-encoded. The maximum size of the raw data is 16 KB.

parameters.name: VSwitchZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the vSwitch.
